title: The Inscribed Bronze Tripod
prompt:
Chiseled into the rim of the ancient bronze tripod is an archaic dedication:

'Name the celestial weapon forged by the elder Cyclopes for the King of the Heavens.'

successOutcome.text: As you whisper 'The Keraunos (Thunderbolt)', a clear ringing vibration hums through the bronze cauldron, and a secret compartment clicks open!

addJournalChronicle.title: The Tripod of Zeus
addJournalChronicle.text: Deciphered the riddle of the Cyclopean weapon and retrieved a consecrated amulet.

hint: The elder Cyclopes Brontes, Steropes, and Arges forged thunder and lightning for Zeus during the Titanomachy.
